_comment: MACHINE-level paths + runtime for BOOKSMITH tools — the portability seam. COPY this file to kit_env.json in this same folder, then edit for YOUR machine. Per-book knobs live in each book's book_config.json, never here. Blocks marked _optional unlock extra capabilities; the kit runs without them. Run `python _tools/doctor.py` to see what your machine supports.

word.note: REQUIRED for Tier-1 print (KDP/Mixam/Blurb interior PDFs, page counts, recto parity): Windows + installed Microsoft Word (docx->PDF via COM is the only page-faithful path). Without Word you still get Tier 2: EPUB, Kindle DOCX, digital-from-existing-PDF, cover compositing + verification.

node.note: REQUIRED (interior DOCX generators). Any Node >= 14. Dependencies ship vendored in _tools/node_modules; if that folder is absent run: npm install --prefix _tools

python.note: REQUIRED: Python 3.10+. Install: pip install -r requirements.txt (repo root). pywin32 is Windows-only (Word COM, Tier-1 print); requests / tiktoken / jsonschema are optional.

cover_gen._optional: OPTIONAL — local AI generation of cover ART (SDXL via ComfyUI). The RUNNER and the DOWNLOADER are vendored in-kit (no external tools): run_workflow points at _tools/comfy_client.py (self-contained, pure-stdlib ComfyUI client) and the checkpoint self-downloads via `python _tools/fetch_weights.py sdxl`. Without any of this, just place your own art in the book's cover_art/ folder — typography compositing (composite_cover.py) and verification work on any machine; art generation is the only thing skipped.
cover_gen.note: EXTERNAL pieces (the only ones): (1) ComfyUI itself, running and serving comfyui_server; (2) a GPU (~8 GB VRAM for SDXL base); (3) the ~6.5 GB checkpoint. Fill checkpoints_dir with your ComfyUI checkpoints folder, then fetch the model with `python _tools/fetch_weights.py sdxl` (resumable). run_workflow / workflows_dir already point at the vendored client + workflow JSONs — leave them unless you supply your own runner. comfyui_skill_dir is legacy/optional (the original hermes runner path); the vendored comfy_client.py supersedes it. AUTO-LAUNCH of ComfyUI requires comfy-cli on PATH (cover_gen runs `comfy launch --background`); the vendored comfy_client.py is a CLIENT only and cannot start a server. If comfy-cli is absent, start ComfyUI yourself so it serves comfyui_server, or pass --no-launch.

vision._optional: OPTIONAL — a LOCAL vision model for the perceptual gates ($0/token, on-box). The PORTABLE DEFAULT is backend='claude': the harness's own vision reads the resized image from disk, zero setup. To use a local llama.cpp multimodal server instead, set backend='keel' and fill every path below.
vision.api: POST http://<host>:<port>/v1/chat/completions (OpenAI format; image as base64 data URI in an image_url content part); read choices[0].message.content
vision.fallback: claude — the harness's own vision via a resize_image_safe.py-resized image read from disk

organs._optional: OPTIONAL accelerators from the reference machine's personal toolkit — safe to leave empty. Every caller has a portable fallback: _tools/resize_image_safe.py replaces imguard; the VENDORED _tools/estimate_tokens.py (tiktoken, or chars/4) replaces the chunker sizer; _tools/fetch_weights.py replaces the personal fetcher for model downloads; your harness's own file/search tools replace chunker and everything.
